data: At approximately what volume number does the line in both graphs become bold and black?

The question asks about the volume number where the lines in both graphs become bold and black. From the caption, it is mentioned that the darker line represents the window of the 5-year minimum epoch length. This implies that the line becomes bold and black at the point where the 5-year minimum epoch length is reached. 

In the top graph (text-to-text), the phase transition occurs at the 548th volume. In the bottom graph (past-to-text), the phase transition occurs at the 325th volume. However, the caption also mentions that the text-to-past case comes close to transitioning at the 548th volume as well. Therefore, the line in both graphs becomes bold and black at approximately the 548th volume.
